subject: CareLyst — custody transfer, go-live priorities and risk heatmap
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jared Langston <jared.langston@carelyst.com>
Cc: Erin Cho <erin.cho@carelyst.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: CareLyst — custody transfer, go-live priorities and risk heatmap

Team / Jared —

Congrats again on the signed LOI. Quick handoff note to get the Success team set up with context and owners so we can hit CareLyst's target go-live (requested): 2027-01-10. High-level items below; I’ve attached the signed LOI and the MVP implementation plan.

Deal summary (short):
- ARR: $420k annual committed consumption (tiered).
- Primary use case: high-throughput inference for clinical triage (text generation + embeddings).
- Data sensitivity: PHI may be present in PII fields; customer requires SOC2 evidence and VPC deployment for production.

Immediate open items (asks for CS):
1) SOW redline and procurement path — CareLyst procurement looped (procurement@carelyst.com). We agreed to net-30 billing after SOW.
2) Security/compliance checklist — they requested preliminary SOC2 artifact list and an audit runbook.
3) Implementation resources — customer will want a pre-prod VPC and one dedicated pool for staging; doc in MVP sheet.
4) Data ingestion — sample export schema + s3 access. Jared, can you confirm the engineering contact for the export (name + email)?

Suggested owners (please reassign if needed):
- Implementation lead (S2CS): Tessa Morgan — take point on onboarding cadence + sprint roster.
- Technical steward: Karthik Iyer — model deployment and infra requirements.
- Security contact: Monica Patel — SOC2 evidence collection and KMS/HSM scoping.

Risk heatmap (quick):
- High: SOC2 artifacts not available by 2027-01-03 (blocks prod sign-off).
- Medium: Data export delays (schema mismatches slow initial ingestion).
- Low: Minor UI customizations (post-prod).

Next steps: Tessa, can you propose a sprint0 timeline and owners? I’ll set a 30-minute sync with Jared + Erin next week to align procurement and timelines.

Attachments: Signed_LOI_CareLyst.pdf (PDF), MVP-implementation-plan.xlsx (XLSX), SOC2-evidence-request.docx (DOCX stub)

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CareLyst — custody transfer, go-live priorities and risk heatmap

Thanks Sean — I’ll take lead on the onboarding. Quick acknowledgement and initial plan below.

Triage & owners (confirmed):
- Sprint0 / timeline owner: Tessa Morgan (onboarding cadence, kickoff, acceptance criteria).
- Infra & deployment: Karthik Iyer (model variants, quantization, dedicated pool sizing).
- Security & compliance: Monica Patel (SOC2 artifact tracker, KMS integration checklist).
- Customer PM & day‑to‑day: Erin Cho (CareLyst) — cc’d.

Sprint0 (proposed cadence):
- Week 0 (2026-11-29 to 2026-12-03): kickoff, access provisioning, SOW finalization, obtain export sample.
- Week 1 (2026-12-06 to 2026-12-10): staging deployment, small-scale ingest, smoke tests.
- Week 2 (2026-12-13 to 2026-12-17): performance tuning, quantization tests, acceptance test plan.
- Blockers to resolve before prod sign-off: SOC2 artifact pack, network peering approval, billing SOW signed.

Immediate asks for CareLyst (Jared / Erin):
- Please share engineer contact for data export + preferred S3 bucket naming convention.
- Confirm the production VPC CIDR and whether CareLyst or Redwood will manage peering.

Risk heatmap (operationalized):
- Action: I will create a one-page "heatmap" doc (owners, mitigation, ETA) and share by Monday.

I’ll propose a 30-minute sync for Tuesday 2026-11-30 10:00am PT — Sean, Monica, Karthik, Jared, Erin. If that works, I’ll send calendar.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CareLyst — custody transfer, go-live priorities and risk heatmap

Looping in a few technical clarifications from my side. Forwarding Sean's summary below for context.

Quoted message follows:
> On Fri, 20 Nov 2026 at 08:15 Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Deal summary (short):
> > - ARR: $420k annual committed consumption (tiered).
> > - Primary use case: high-throughput inference for clinical triage (text generation + embeddings).

Technical asks / notes:
- Staging footprint: recommend starting with 2x A10G-equivalent instances in the dedicated pool for staging (allow headroom for perf tests).
- Production baseline: plan for burstable reserved pool ~8k tokens/s sustained; will size exactly after perf profile but allocate capacity planning now.
- Model variants: customer expects to run 3 variants (base quantized, 4-bit tuned, and larger for legacy prompts). We should provision KV cache sizing for the larger variant.
- Observability hooks: include tracing key in sprint0 so CS can correlate token-level cost to customer routes in Console.

Action items for me:
- I’ll attach a short infra sizing estimate after I review the MVP plan. Expect that by Monday EOD PST.
- I’ll need the sample payload schema and one sample record to run a dry ingest.

Thanks — Karthik
